scope: Regular-file filtering and stream/name order in HackScsd_FindFile, src/hack_scsd.c
finding: exFAT lookup ignored the directory attribute and accepted repeated stream-extension entries. A matching directory or malformed entry group could be selected as an image/file.
change: Carry regular-file eligibility from the primary entry. Accept one stream extension before filename entries, and reject empty names. Retain prior NUL-safe matching and ASCII case folding.
verification: check_scsd_exfat_names.py: all 65536 attribute words with valid, swapped, duplicated, inactive, short-count and empty-name entry groups (393216 cases)
Existing 196608 string-length/mismatch and cross-sector cases still pass
A matching directory followed by a matching regular file selects the latter and its own metadata
Baseline eec2017 fails the full fixture and isolated --directory-only scenario
Existing FAT directory fixture passes; GNU ARM compilation passes without diagnostics
limitations: Controlled directory sectors. Reserved attribute bits, entry-set checksums, optional secondary types, 64-bit file sizes, device capacity and real hardware remain unverified. This is selected entry validation, not full exFAT conformance.
